# Kenney Assets

This folder contains a small subset of Kenney's **Abstract Platformer** asset
pack used by the `SideScrollerTutorial` demo.

Source:

```text
https://kenney.nl/assets/abstract-platformer
```

Downloaded file:

```text
https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/abstract-platformer/a8f4badcb5-1677579172/kenney_abstract-platformer.zip
```

License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal.

Only the PNG files required by the demo are copied into the repository. The
demo does not use Nintendo-owned names, sprites, music, sound effects, logos,
or level data.
